meta.title: Affirmity — A daily practice for the mind you're building
meta.description: Affirmity pairs daily affirmations with guided meditation, journaling, and a streak tracker — one quiet practice, said daily.

hero.headline: Say it daily. Become it.
hero.body: Affirmity pairs daily affirmations with guided meditation, journaling, and a streak that keeps you honest — a single quiet practice for the story you tell yourself.
hero.imageAlt: Affirmity key art — a sketched face with glowing eyes and a circle-in-triangle mark at the forehead

flagship.label: The core practice
flagship.headline: One affirmation. Every day.
flagship.body: Affirmity's flagship feature is simple by design: a new affirmation surfaces each day, written to be said out loud, sat with, or carried through the hours after it. Repetition is the mechanism — the app exists to help you show up for it, daily.

items.title: Guided meditation, in more than one shape
items.body: Choose from multiple guided meditation types and categories inside the app, matched to how much time — and quiet — you have.

items.title: A place to write it down
items.body: Journal alongside your affirmation practice — a private, running record of what you're working through, kept inside the app.

items.title: The practice, tracked
items.body: A streak and habit tracker keeps the practice honest. Showing up daily is the point — Affirmity keeps count so you don't have to.
